in_marathi.name: Nabab
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the night, God of the new moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Nabhah’ meaning ‘sky’ or ‘heavens’, the name Nabab is a revered title given to the Hindu god of the night, Chandra, or the moon god. Nabab is also known as the god of the new moon and is considered a symbol of creation, regeneration, and new beginnings.

Nabab is also known as the god of the new moon and is considered a symbol of creation, regeneration, and new beginnings.
